The guild has a WPS Cloud Document for recording member information, along with other features. {"Click here to access it" | "link": "https://www.kdocs.cn/l/cvM5Vz8Fd3dC"}.

We have achieved automatic calculation of TP points through tiering, automatic counting of owned Super petals, cell member addition permissions (requiring the addition of flowerwsr as a {"contact" | "link": "https://kdocs.cn/i/MfxUDULv"} in WPS), and even automatic leaderboard updates.

Although the {"Mark List" | "link": "https://v.wjx.cn/vm/tJTix5n.aspx#"} is not commonly used, it does not mean we lack it—it's a matter of whether the guild's prestige is significant.

Several quick links were also inserted into the table cells, such as {"DPS calculation" | "link": "https://storm-let.github.io/florr-dps/"} and viewing the Surviving {"Super" | "link": "https://mobs.ashish.top"} creatures.

Add the guild leader's WeChat: Zjk-1332 (Available during weekends) To quickly join the guild group chat!
